fusions.name: Dropped Weight
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 7 tiles onto the target and deals 18 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Itch Swat
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 2 tiles; each hit deals 4 damage. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Braced Vault
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Quickened Bulk
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
